title: Lore Warden
dek: Three themes. Nine boons. Compare the effects and costs below.
sources: Fenumion 21–25 · Lore Warden · A1:H60 · checked 17 October 2026 · https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Qk8H3SMq7-8_raesIkaPdNoq4XqgNsJpZRStwlg278o/edit#gid=1611649013

Read down each theme to compare its three tiers. Each boon shows its listed cost. Open “Full original wording” for the complete passage, including its descriptive text.

Tier 22cost
Tier 33cost
Theme 1

The Ancient

Tier 1Cost 1

You gain expertise in history if you are already proficient, or proficiency if you aren't

Full original wording

You have studied beneath dead trees, within ruined temples, and beside ancient flames. The world remembers you as much as you remember it. You gain expertise in history if you are already proficient, or proficiency if you aren't

Tier 2Cost 2

Once per short rest, you can cast a ritual spell of 4th level or lower you know as an action while still not requiring a spell slot.

Full original wording

You remember spells so complex they have passed out of teaching, their patterns alive in your memory as if written yesterday. Once per short rest, you can cast a ritual spell of 4th level or lower you know as an action while still not requiring a spell slot.

Tier 3Cost 3

Once per day, you may cast a transmutation or abjuration spell that you know but do not have prepared.

Full original wording

With one hand, you transform the world; with the other, you shield it from harm. Your will is both the hammer and the wall. Once per day, you may cast a transmutation or abjuration spell that you know but do not have prepared.

Theme 2

The Scholar

Tier 1Cost 1

You gain expertise in arcana if you are already proficient or proficiency if you aren't

Full original wording

You do not learn spells—you remember them. The ancient arcana stirs within your soul like a storm waiting to rise. You gain expertise in arcana if you are already proficient or proficiency if you aren't

Tier 2Cost 2

You gain a bonus to scribing rolls equal to your spellcasting modifier. If you fail while using this bonus, the spell is impossible to attempt to ever scribe again

Full original wording

Your duty is not to rule or destroy, but to remember—and in remembering, to protect the fragile thread of truth. You gain a bonus to scribing rolls equal to your spellcasting modifier. If you fail while using this bonus, the spell is impossible to attempt to ever scribe again

Tier 3Cost 3

You may prepare five extra spells from the Enchantment, Evocation, or Necromancy schools

Full original wording

To you, the arcane is not a study—it is a cosmos. You swim through spells as others walk through air, touching forces ungrasped by mortal minds. You may prepare five extra spells from the Enchantment, Evocation, or Necromancy schools

Theme 3

The Traveler

Tier 1Cost 1

You gain expertise in nature if you are already proficient, or proficiency if you aren't

Full original wording

Nature’s mysteries unfold before you like a well-read tome, every plant, stone, and animal a passage to be studied and understood. You gain expertise in nature if you are already proficient, or proficiency if you aren't

Tier 2Cost 2

Your Planeshift spell may bypass the void.

Full original wording

The broken world tries to cage you, but your spirit slips through cracks and tears like wind through shattered glass. Your Planeshift spell may bypass the void.

Tier 3Cost 3

You are immune to exhaustion from anything less than 8th level spells or monsters with legendary actions.

Full original wording

You carry a flame that burns through weakness, pushing you ever forward despite mortal limits. You are immune to exhaustion from anything less than 8th level spells or monsters with legendary actions.
